verdict.rationale: Anthropic ships an official template SKILL.md with placeholder `name` and `description` frontmatter. The Agent Skills specification documents the required YAML frontmatter, the description field's constraints, and the directory layout, and a skill-creator skill exists to author new skills, so developers need not reverse-engineer existing ones. A runtime probe confirmed spec-conformant SKILL.md frontmatter reads back cleanly after install. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of authoring a new skill from the template end-to-end, and documented constraints for the `name` field in the evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can author a new skill from a documented template — a SKILL.md with name and description frontmatter — without reverse-engineering existing skills
